html: I was just thinking, since Clinton, Bush, Trump were born within three months of each other (Trump in June 1946, Bush in July 1946, Clinton in August 1946) wouldn't it be interesting if, when they died in 2038, they'd die within three months of each other? Say Trump dies in March, for example, then Bush dies in April, and Clinton in May. I think fringe conspiracy theorists would have a field day with that one (NWO, Illuminati, etc)
